author: Forbes
description:
For @CalebWSimpson, earning the attention of more than 11 million followers across social media began with two simple questions: "How much do you pay for rent?" And, "Can I have a tour of your home?"

"Most New Yorkers told me to f*** off, straight up. ...Eventually, someone said yes, and it went viral overnight because everyone’s so nosy.” (Consider us clocked.)

Typically amassing over 1 million views, his home tour videos offer a fascinating peek into the world of everyday (and sometimes famous) people, and the places that bring them pride.

This week, Simpson joins #ForbesTalksShop host Spencer Dukoff (@SpensurrDoocough) to discuss his approach to storytelling, the importance of rejection and the people who inspire him. Watch the full episode at the link in bio.
title: Caleb Simpson Talks Shop

author: Forbes
description:
Caleb Simpson didn’t build his massive social media following by trying to sell people a fantasy apartment. He built that audience by having the courage—and vision—to ask strangers to simply open the door.

In this episode of Forbes Talks Shop hosted by Spencer Dukoff, the creator behind viral home-tour interviews opens up about how one simple question (“Can I see your apartment?”) turned into a career built on curiosity, connection and trust.

He also shares why people are so fascinated by the way strangers live, what he’s learned from stepping inside homes around the world and how rejection—not to mention walking, lighting candles and a fully charged cell phone—all became part of his creative process.
